title: SYNC 2/SYNC 3 audio system overview
introduction:
The touchscreen gets the attention, but the audio system is an ensemble: speakers, control modules, antennas, media connections and driver controls all have their own parts to play. I start by matching the equipment qualifiers to the car, especially Shaker and optional features.

Use this overview to identify the system’s main pieces and feature names. It does not provide connector locations, operating thresholds, feature-setting instructions or diagnostic tests.

edits.text: Use the component list to identify the hardware, then the feature list to see the functions included for the applicable equipment.
edits.why: An equipment inventory helps establish what belongs on the car before a missing feature is mistaken for a fault.
Match the speaker configuration to the installed audio package.
The Shaker equipment qualifier determines which speaker count applies.
FDIM means front display interface module: the display is an identified component within the wider audio system.

edits.text: ACM, containing DACMC for 2.3L and 5.2L applications.
edits.why: ACM means audio front control module; DACMC means digital audio control module C. Keep the engine qualifier attached to the contained module.

edits.text: AM / FM antenna, with HD Radio® for the Shaker configuration.
edits.why: Keep the HD Radio® equipment qualifier when identifying the radio equipment.
This module handles SYNC connected-device, voice and media functions, working with separate audio and display components.

edits.text: Audio DSP module — digital signal processing module.
edits.why: Retain this module’s identity separately from the other audio controllers.

edits.text: Audio switches on the RH side of the steering wheel.
Shaker subwoofer amplifier, where Shaker is fitted.

edits.why: The microphone supplies voice input to the connected SYNC system.

edits.text: ANC — active noise control, for 2.3L only.
edits.why: Keep the engine restriction when identifying this feature.

edits.text: ESE — engine sound enhancement, for 2.3L and 5.2L only.
edits.why: This identifies an engine-specific sound feature, separate from active noise control.

edits.text: SIRIUS Data Services capability, if equipped.

edits.why: The APIM supports the system’s connected-device, voice and media functions.
